registration_kind: local prospective lock before pilot/scientific runs; not a public registry
pilot_use: code/budget validation only; no scientific claims

changes.uniform_budget: only step allocation changed; first-round anchor changes as a mediated consequence
changes.no_mix_fixed_time: identity state mix; restart time held to full=.7**(1/3)
changes.zero_restart_time: same state mix and allocation; later integration starts at zero

all_framework_calls_use_same_arm_name: evidence_driven; avoid changing arm-keyed random input policy
primary_metric: projection-FID with existing fixed128D projection and full10k test reference
secondary_metric: projection-KID degree3 polynomial U-statistic; fixed1000 reference subset rng20261103, exploratory, not Inception KID
primary_tests: 8 full-versus-component paired-seed contrasts (4 components x2 checkpoints), two-sided t df2 with Holm family correction; mean control-minus-full and raw/unadjusted CI also reported
effect_floor: 1 projection-FID unit; statistical evidence alone does not establish practical improvement or frontier win
reproduction_guard: each scientific baseline/full at seed42/43/44 must match historical S50 same-checkpoint seed FID within1e-4; failure halts scientific interpretation
visual_selection: first64 generated indices, same arms and seeds; no result-based selection
